text:
ITEM 1 | Pale green shredded leafy vegetable (romaine-like lettuce pieces, ribbons about 3-6 cm long) coated in a creamy off-white dressing with fine pale shavings of hard cheese scattered throughout; moist, glossy sheen on leaves, sits on the left third of the plate covering roughly 25% of plate area, about 3 cm tall | 120

ITEM 2 | Cluster of bright green broccoli florets, firm and slightly glossy, with some stems, about 2-4 cm florets, arranged across the upper right of the plate covering roughly 20% of plate area, piled about 2-3 cm high, sitting beside and partly on the lettuce | 110

ITEM 3 | Reddish-brown cooked rice grains, short and slightly sticky-looking, dry and separate with a matte surface, forming a crumbly mound about 7 cm wide and 1.5 cm tall at the bottom center of the plate, next to the lettuce | 90

ITEM 4 | Chunk of orange-red tomato piece, glossy skin with slightly wet surface, about 3 cm long and 2 cm wide, leaning against the broccoli at the top center of the plate | 25

ITEM 5 | Pale golden-cream cooked fish or poultry-like pieces with flaky, opaque light tan surfaces and some light browning at edges, about 6 cm by 4 cm total, slightly glossy with a little sauce, sitting on the right-center of the plate beside the rice | 100

ITEM 6 | Scattered thin dark green arugula-like leaves and stems, flat and slightly wilted, spread across the fish and rice edges, about 1-2 cm per leaf, covering roughly 8% of plate area | 15

ITEM 7 | Light brown seasoning or sauce bits, small flecks and glaze-like residue with a dull, slightly oily sheen, dotted over the fish and greens, about 1 cm patches | 8
